welcome.title: Welcome to Save Up!
welcome.description: We'll show the main places: adding transactions, reading your budget, checking reports, and adjusting settings.

navigation.title: Bottom menu
navigation.description: Use these buttons to return to the dashboard, open the report, or go to settings at any time.

balance.title: Your balance
balance.description: This is the money currently available. If the starting amount is wrong, tap the number and enter the correct balance.

amount-input.title: Income & expenses
amount-input.description: Enter an amount manually, then choose Income or Expense. For expenses, the app asks for a category so analytics stay useful.

daily-limit.title: Daily budget
daily-limit.description: This shows how much you can spend per day if your current balance is spread evenly until the end of the month.

savings.title: Savings pocket
savings.description: Move money from balance into savings, bring it back when needed, and set a goal to track progress.

templates.title: Recurring actions
templates.description: Add templates for regular transactions like rent, salary, or internet. Then run them with one tap.

report-tabs.title: Report modes
report-tabs.description: Open Analytics to see spending by category. You can still switch to income, spending, or full history here.

report-month.title: Report month
report-month.description: Choose any month here to view that month's income, spending, analytics, and history. Pick a past month to compare it with the current one.

report-summary.title: Analytics overview
report-summary.description: Start with total expenses and the top category. They show how much was spent and where the main share went.

report-details.title: Category bars
report-details.description: Each row is a category: the amount is on the right, the percent shows its share, and the bar makes categories easy to compare.

report-new-month.title: New month
report-new-month.description: When the month is over, click here to reset your spending statistics while keeping your balance and savings intact.

settings-theme.title: Appearance
settings-theme.description: Choose light, dark, or automatic theme so the app feels comfortable to use.

settings-language.title: Language
settings-language.description: Change the interface language here. Your choice is saved for the next launch.

settings-currency.title: Currency
settings-currency.description: Choose the currency used for balances, expenses, savings, and reports.

settings-reset.title: Reset data
settings-reset.description: Permanently delete all transactions, savings, and templates to start fresh.

done.title: You're all set!
done.description: You can now add your first transaction. The bottom menu will always take you back to the section you need.

voice-input.title: Voice input
voice-input.description: Tap the microphone to add a transaction by voice. AI will detect the amount and category.

report-heatmap.title: Activity heatmap
report-heatmap.description: Each cell is a day. The brighter the color, the more you spent. Tap a cell to see details.

report-export.title: Export to Excel
report-export.description: Download all transactions for the selected month as an Excel file.

settings-categories.title: Categories & limits
settings-categories.description: Rename categories, add custom ones, and set spending limits.

settings-notifications.title: Reminders
settings-notifications.description: Choose how often the bot reminds you to log your spending.

settings-security.title: PIN & biometrics
settings-security.description: Lock the app with a PIN code. Add Face ID or fingerprint for quick access.

notFound.title: This route does not exist
notFound.description: Return to the dashboard to continue tracking your budget.

trend.description: Spending by day of the selected month.
